# AgentBoard

> Local-first kanban task board and durable project memory for humans and autonomous coding agents.

AgentBoard stores projects, tasks, version history, comments, and knowledge notes as readable Markdown files. It exposes the same data through a web UI, REST API, and Model Context Protocol server.

## Primary links

- Documentation and source: https://github.com/Vladev0/agentboard
- Releases: https://github.com/Vladev0/agentboard/releases
- Issue tracker: https://github.com/Vladev0/agentboard/issues
- License: MIT

## Useful capabilities

- Durable task queue across agent context resets and sessions
- Explicit needs-human-input flag independent of workflow status
- A review stage separating agent-complete from human-verified work
- Versioned project-memory notes linked with wiki syntax
- Seventeen MCP tools for projects, tasks, comments, status, and memory
- Local Markdown storage with no hosted database
